title: Intrinsic Meets Extrinsic Fairness: Assessing the Downstream Impact of Bias Mitigation in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring intrinsic bias by calculating the probability gap between stereotypical and antistereotypical text completions for gendered terms (e.g., 'men' vs. 'women') across different contexts. Measuring extrinsic bias by computing group fairness metrics (Accuracy Parity, Demographic Parity Difference, and Equality of Odds) on downstream financial classification tasks using binary gender as the sensitive attribute.

Evaluating the intrinsic associations language models make between demographic groups and socioeconomic descriptors (poverty vs. wealth) using a probability-based evaluation approach, and assessing allocational harms via real-world financial classification tasks such as salary prediction, employment status, and creditworthiness.
